lines.t:
A state of <c:ffff00>charging<c> for a set time without using
<c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>. The <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> rises little by little.

The <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> is the <c:ffff00>legs<c>. No other <c:ffff00>act<c> can be
performed and the Medabot becomes <c:ffff00>unable to<c>
<c:ffff00>evade<c>.

If any {{part}} is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>, charging is interrupted and
the next command is chosen right away.
